meta.name: Model AI policy
meta.note: A reference AI policy. Every assessment question is tagged to the clause(s) it evidences, so the assessment doubles as a policy compliance check. Adapt the statements to your organisation; keep the ids stable.

clauses.title: Scope, ownership and accountability
clauses.statement: Every AI system, agent, and MCP server in use is recorded in an inventory and has one named accountable owner.

clauses.title: Acceptable and prohibited use
clauses.statement: AI may be used only for approved purposes. Prohibited uses and the escalation route are written down and communicated.

clauses.title: Risk classification and assessment
clauses.statement: Each AI system is risk-classified and assessed before deployment and again on any material change.

clauses.title: Data protection and secrets
clauses.statement: AI systems receive only the data a task needs. Secrets and credentials never enter prompts, context, memory, logs, or training data.

clauses.title: Identity, access and least privilege
clauses.statement: Agents and AI tools act under their own identity with short-lived, narrowly scoped access. No standing access to secrets.

clauses.title: Human oversight and autonomy limits
clauses.statement: Autonomy limits are defined per system. High-impact actions require human approval, and a human can pause or stop any agent.

clauses.title: Third-party models, tools and MCP servers
clauses.statement: Models, plugins, MCP servers and their dependencies come from approved sources, are version-pinned, and are reviewed before use and on change.

clauses.title: Security testing and evaluation
clauses.statement: AI systems are tested for security, accuracy and misuse before release and on a schedule, with results recorded against defined metrics.

clauses.title: Logging, monitoring and incident response
clauses.statement: AI actions and tool calls are logged and monitored. AI incidents follow the incident process, including regulatory reporting where required.

clauses.title: Transparency and user disclosure
clauses.statement: People are told when they interact with AI or receive AI-generated content, and system documentation states purpose, limits and known failure modes.

clauses.title: Change management and lifecycle
clauses.statement: Changes to models, prompts, tools and configuration go through change control, and retired systems are decommissioned with their access removed.

clauses.title: Training and AI literacy
clauses.statement: Staff who build, run or use AI systems are trained on this policy and on the risks of the systems they use.
